shortDescription: Philippine annual inflation (PHCPI=ECI) was 6.1% in August, slightly slower than the previous month's 6.2% rate, the statistics agency said on Friday.It was just above the 6% median forecast in a Reuters poll and was within the central bank's 5.5% to 6.5% forecast range for the month.

children: Philippine annual inflation (PHCPI=ECI) was 6.1% in August, slightly slower than the previous month's 6.2% rate, the statistics agency said on Friday.
It was just above the 6% median forecast in a Reuters poll and was within the central bank's 5.5% to 6.5% forecast range for the month.
